planning.causality.bento1Body: No scene may open with “and then this happened”. Every scene exists only because the preceding resolution created an untenable state.
planning.causality.bento2Body: Scenes without a resolved conflict create dead dramaturgical space. The chain exposes narrative dead ends before you invest thousands of words.
planning.causality.bento3Body: Changes to a scene in the editor flow straight back into the causality strip. The overview stays a faithful mirror of your manuscript.
planning.causality.chainGaps: Causal thread: {count, plural, one {# open gap} other {# open gaps}}
planning.causality.emptyNote: Write or plan your first scene right in the storyboard — the causality strip shapes itself afterwards, all on its own.
planning.causality.gapStatus: Status: {count, plural, one {# open gap} other {# open gaps}}
planning.causality.laterNote: The causality strip mirrors only your real scene entries.
planning.causality.subtitle: An honest causal chain: how each scene forces the next — conflict, consequence and the hand-off through cause & effect.
planning.causality.title: Causality strip
planning.crud.dateHint: Free text, e.g. “2278”, “Day 03 (04:12)” — or leave it empty
planning.crud.deleteNote: The event is deleted for good.
planning.crud.error: Saving failed. Your answers stay as they are — try again.
planning.crud.namesHint: Separate names with Enter or a comma — plain text, no links.
planning.crud.positionHint: A number of your own ordering — empty leaves the event unordered at the end
planning.crud.positionInteger: The position is a whole number.
planning.crud.remove: Remove the event from the chronology for good
planning.heading: Planning
planning.storyboard.beatsHint: One beat per entry — Enter or a comma commits it.
planning.storyboard.conflictBody: This chapter was saved differently since you opened it — perhaps in another window. Saving your unsaved answers overwrites the standing version.
planning.storyboard.discardDraftBody: Your edited version of “{title}” is lost — the chapter keeps its saved scenes.
planning.storyboard.drillInChip: CHAPTER {position} · {count, plural, one {# SCENE} other {# SCENES}}
planning.storyboard.drillInNone: Choose a chapter to work on its scenes.
planning.storyboard.emptyNote: Start with chapter 1 in the writing workspace or pick one of the five structures first — your chapters join their stages on their own.
planning.storyboard.remapDialogBody: Every chapter moves to the stage its position suggests in the new structure:
planning.storyboard.remapError: The structure change failed. Try again.
planning.storyboard.remapNote: When the structure changes, every chapter keeps its relative position in the novel. The stage assignment is precomputed and suggested for the new structure.
planning.storyboard.remapUnknownStructur: The server does not know this structure — the change was refused.
planning.storyboard.removeScene: Remove the scene from the chapter
planning.storyboard.sceneTitleHint: Leave it empty to keep the scene untitled.
planning.storyboard.scenesTotal: {count, plural, one {# scene in total} other {# scenes in total}}
planning.storyboard.structureNote: Chapters keep their relative position in the novel (0–100%)
planning.storyboard.title: Storyboard & story structure
planning.timeline.emptyNote: Add the first event and date it in your own words.
planning.timeline.eventsWithoutDate: {count, plural, one {# event without a date} other {# events without a date}}
planning.timeline.newUndatedNote: It is ordered by hand once the date is settled
planning.timeline.orderedCount: {count, plural, one {# placed event} other {# placed events}}
planning.timeline.scenesComplete: {count, plural, one {# written scene} other {# written scenes}}
planning.timeline.scenesInProgress: {count, plural, one {# scene in progress} other {# scenes in progress}}
planning.timeline.scenesPlanned: {count, plural, one {# planned scene} other {# planned scenes}}
planning.timeline.subtitle: A manually dated sequence in free-text time
planning.timeline.title: Chronology & events
planning.timeline.unorderedNote: Fragments without a fixed position — they stand at the end
